title: Curating Cuttlefish
statement: Drifting through warm, tea-tinted water lit by shafts of dusty gold, this palm-sized cephalopod spends its days quietly arranging smooth river stones, frosted sea glass, and spiral shells into neat, color-graded collections along its mossy slate ledges. Whenever it finishes a particularly satisfying arrangement, soft pastel patterns ripple across its velvety skin like quiet thoughts.
